consumer: game::handle_action's ACTION_RELOAD_WIELDED dispatch site, which calls avatar_action::reload_wielded() to PERFORM the reload of the avatar's wielded gun through the engine's own active input loop
scope: the character's own wielded weapon and the ammo reload_wielded() would itself select/consume; not a map region or external inventory
decisive_source: src/handle_action.cpp::game::handle_action (ACTION_RELOAD_WIELDED) — its body invokes avatar_action::reload_wielded(), running the registered reload action via the engine input-dispatch path rather than re-deriving a loaded end-state
divergence: Wielded gun unloaded with one unambiguous compatible ammo stack in inventory: the real action consumes that ammo stack (removing/decrementing it) and spends moves, whereas a shortcut that merely sets the gun's charges leaves the ammo item still in inventory and moves unchanged
